name: Multi-Series Line
description: A multi-series time-series line chart with pointer tooltips and an optional slider that rebases every series to a chosen date = 100. Column mapping is prop-driven — xKey, yKey and groupKey name the date, value and series fields — so it reads any long-format table; pass colorDomain to pin partisan series to the theme's semantic party colors. Reach for it to compare a handful of series' levels, or switch to index mode to compare their relative growth.
